characters.summary: Ash Ketchum is a tenacious Pokémon Trainer who relies on a diverse team of loyal Pokémon to battle opponents. He commands his partners using dynamic tactical instructions, utilizing special mechanics like Mega Evolution, Z-Moves, and Dynamax depending on the region.
weaknesses: Relies heavily on his Pokémon partners rather than personal combat prowess
Prone to emotional distress when his Pokémon are severely injured
limitations: Limited to carrying six Pokémon at a time
Must command partners from the sidelines

characters.summary: Atreus is a skilled archer and tracker who combines swift mobility with magical abilities and shapeshifting. He fights using his Talon Bow, summon runes, and a unique ability to transform into large beasts when overwhelmed.
weaknesses: Prone to emotional volatility
Vulnerable to heavy physical overpowering when separated from his father
limitations: Relies on his bow and arrows for primary ranged offense

sources.supports: Abilities, shapeshifting, combat skills, and gear.

Infiltrated Asgard and operated independently within enemy territory.

conditional.dependsOn: High Spartan Rage or emotional stress

Can transform into a giant bear or wolf during combat.

characters.summary: Bayonetta is an ancient and powerful Umbra Witch who blends devastating gunplay, martial arts, and wicked weave magic. She manipulates time to dodge attacks and summons infernal demons to crush her adversaries.
weaknesses: Vulnerable if caught off guard while Witch Time is exhausted
Bound by contract to infernal entities
limitations: Relies on continuous dodging to maintain temporal advantages
Magic meter depletes when using certain summoned weapons

sources.supports: Detailed combat abilities, Witch Time, and wicked weaves.

feats.claim: Defeated Jubileus, the Creator, and punched her soul into the sun.
Defeated the God of Chaos, Singularity.

notableResults.note: Final duel after breaking mind control.
Climax battle atop a falling clock tower.

campaignTags.claim: Employs Umbran witchcraft to summon demons and manipulate reality.
Opens portals to Inferno to execute finishing moves.
Transforms into a swarm of bats or butterflies to instantly reposition.

unknowns: Exact ceiling of infernal demon strength when fully manifested.

characters.summary: Big Boss is a legendary mercenary and master of stealth, tactical espionage, and close-quarters combat (CQC). He utilizes advanced military hardware, suppressed weaponry, and environment utilization to outmaneuver heavily armed foes.
weaknesses: Physically human with standard biological limitations
Vulnerable to overwhelming futuristic technology and supernatural phenomena without specialized preparation
limitations: Relies on conventional firearms and tactical gear
Subject to standard human fatigue and injury

Detailed CQC techniques, equipment, and notable feats.

feats.claim: Defeated The Boss in hand-to-hand combat.
Destroyed multiple nuclear-equipped Metal Gear prototypes single-handedly.

notableResults.note: Final duel in a field of white flowers.

campaignTags.claim: Master of infiltration using camouflage and silent takedowns.
Utilizes Fulton recovery systems, night vision goggles, and sonar devices.

unknowns: Exact recovery time from severe shrapnel-induced trauma in later years.

characters.summary: Blinky is the red ghost who aggressively pursues Pac-Man across mazes with relentless speed. He increases his movement velocity and tracking precision dynamically as fewer pellets remain in the maze.

mechanisms: Intangible ghost form (vulnerable only when Pac-Man eats a Power Pellet)

weaknesses: Vulnerable to being eaten by Pac-Man when a Power Pellet is active
Restricted to moving within maze pathways
mobility: Floating ghost movement through maze corridors
limitations: Cannot deviate from grid-based maze paths
Powerless when frightened by Power Pellets

sources.supports: Ghost behaviors, characteristics, and gameplay mechanics.
Detailed AI behavior, Cruising Spurt mechanics, and role in the maze.

feats.claim: Successfully cornered and eliminated Pac-Man countless times across arcade mazes.

notableResults.note: Captured Pac-Man upon direct contact during standard pursuit.

campaignTags.claim: Operates as a spectral entity capable of passing through walls.

unknowns: Sentience level beyond programmed maze AI routines.

characters.summary: Bowser is the formidable King of the Koopas who relies on brute physical strength, heavy shell defense, and fiery breath attacks. He frequently kidnaps Princess Peach and employs advanced machinery, magic, and airships to overwhelm opponents.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to lava and bridge collapse switches
Low agility compared to agile opponents like Mario
limitations: Heavy weight limits acceleration and quick dodging

sources.supports: General character overview, abilities, and role in the franchise.
Detailed combat feats, fire breath, shell attacks, and weaknesses.

feats.claim: Survived being submerged in lava and falling into castle depths multiple times.
Conquered kingdoms and manipulated cosmic power stars.

notableResults.note: Defeated when the bridge support switch was triggered.

campaignTags.claim: Breathes massive streams of destructive fire.
Displays flight capabilities in various spin-offs and airship battles.
Naturally stands well over 8 feet tall and towers over ordinary humans.

unknowns: Exact limits of his durability against high-tier cosmic energy blasts.

characters.summary: Dreamy Bowser is an immensely empowered form achieved when Bowser absorbs the Dream Stone. He gains reality-warping powers, invulnerability, giant skeletal wings, and the ability to summon hordes of minions instantaneously.
weaknesses: Dependent on the structural integrity of the Dream Stone
Vulnerable to counter-attacks once the Dream Stone is fractured
characters.formDifferences: Replaces standard base capabilities with godlike reality-warping power, flight via giant skeletal wings, and invulnerability granted by the Dream Stone.

sources.supports: Form capabilities, Dream Stone powers, and combat moves.

unknowns: Exact duration of form stability without the Dream Stone.

characters.summary: Dry Bowser is the skeletal undead iteration of Bowser. He is immune to standard physical trauma, capable of tossing regenerating bone projectiles, and can spew blue hellfire.

mechanisms: Skeletal body immunity to blunt physical trauma

weaknesses: Vulnerable to being dissolved in lava (though he can reform later)
Lack of soft tissue makes him susceptible to total structural disintegration if completely crushed
limitations: Bones can be scattered temporarily by heavy explosions
characters.formDifferences: Replaces flesh and blood with an indestructible skeleton that crumbles and reforms instead of taking conventional damage.

sources.supports: Undead attributes, bone-throwing attacks, and durability features.

feats.claim: Reassembled his entire skeletal frame after falling into lava and dissolving.

notableResults.note: Defeated by activating the bridge switch, plunging him into lava.

campaignTags.claim: Instantly reassembles his skeleton after being crushed or shattered.

unknowns: Full extent of magic required to maintain the skeletal curse.

weaknesses: Vulnerable to the light of the Giga Bell and Giga Cat Mario form
Prone to exhaustion after prolonged rampages
characters.formDifferences: Amplifies Bowser to kaiju proportions with corrupted black fur, spiked shell, and cataclysmic environmental destruction capabilities.

sources.supports: Kaiju size, dark magic corruption, and attacks.

feats.claim: Rampaged across Lake Lapcat, reshaping the geography with his immense size and fire.

notableResults.note: Defeated after intense combat with giant Giga Cat Mario.

campaignTags.claim: Grown to immense kaiju proportions, towering over islands.

Large hitbox makes him easy to target with ranged attacks
